trans-unit.source: So, they're now calling us the Heroes of Legend...
trans-unit.target: So, they're now calling us the Heroes of Legend...

trans-unit.source: Like they say, history is created by great men.
trans-unit.target: Like they say, history is created by great men.

trans-unit.source: But, really, Edward should have been the one to defeat Dhaos.
trans-unit.target: But, really, Edward should have been the one to defeat Dhaos.

trans-unit.source: Fame was not his objective. Of course, neither was ours.
trans-unit.target: Fame was not his objective. Of course, neither was ours.

trans-unit.source: Let them call us whatever they like.
trans-unit.target: Let them call us whatever they like.

trans-unit.source: Okay... But it still doesn't seem right to me.
